docs.title: Configure Your Workspace, Discuss, Outbound Email, and AI Assistant

sections.text: Use the company switcher to control which company records you view and edit. Open **Settings** to configure global and company-specific options, manage users, passwords, SSO, and access rights, collaborate with teammates through **Discuss**, **Chatter**, **Activities**, and **Outbound Email**, and interact with the built-in **AI Assistant**.

Before adjusting settings or managing users, verify your assigned access rights: * **Settings Administration**: Required to modify global and company-level module settings, manage users, companies, access groups, sequences, and technical parameters. * **Internal User**: Can view records within assigned companies, switch active companies, adjust personal preferences (**My preferences**), post messages and log notes in chatter, and use the AI Assistant when a provider is configured. * **Active Company Assignment**: Every user must belong to at least one active company before creating company-dependent documents.

You can open configuration settings from the **Settings** app or directly via **Configuration → Settings** inside Accounting, Purchase, Sales, or Inventory: 1. Open **Settings** from the app switcher. 2. In the left sidebar, pick the application whose configuration you want to inspect (Settings, Accounting, Purchase, Sales, Inventory, Reporting, Notes, Web, and installed themes). 3. Use the **Search settings** bar at the top to filter options across all sections; clear the search input or press **Escape** to restore the full list. 4. Select the scope toggle: * **Current company**: Changes apply only to the company shown in the top-right header. * **Global settings**: Changes apply across the entire database. 5. Toggle checkboxes or adjust values, then click **Save** (Alt+S). Click **Discard** (Alt+J) to cancel unsaved changes. ![General Settings lets administrators toggle company-scoped or global options across every installed application.](/en/next/assets/docs/assets/user-manual/getting-started/general-settings.webp)

From the **Settings** top menu, open **Users & Companies**: 1. **Users** (**Settings → Users & Companies → Users**): Create internal users, assign allowed companies, set default company, and configure per-application access roles (for example, Accounting Read-Only vs Accountant, Purchase User vs Administrator, HR User vs Officer). 2. **Companies** (**Settings → Users & Companies → Companies**): Maintain legal name, currency, address, tax ID, logo, and parent/subsidiary hierarchy for multi-company setups. 3. **Groups** (**Settings → Users & Companies → Groups**): Review or audit feature-level permission groups (such as Lot and Serial Tracking, Budgeting & AVC, or Group Consolidation). 4. **Personal Preferences, Identity Confirmation & Password Changes**: * Click your profile name in the top-right corner and choose **My preferences** to change your interface language, light/dark/system theme, notification preference, or password. * Sensitive security actions prompt a dedicated **Confirm identity** dialog (with an inline show/hide eye button). * Administrators resetting accounts via **Users → Reset passwords** see each selected user in an individual labeled section; leaving a user's password blank keeps their current password unchanged. 5. **SSO Identity Providers & MCP Connections**: Settings administrators can configure **OpenID Connect (OIDC)** single sign-on providers (with built-in diagnostics), audit active user sessions, and review delegated **MCP Connections** under **Settings → Technical**. ![The Users list shows every active account, login identifier, and assigned company scope.](/en/next/assets/docs/assets/user-manual/getting-started/users-list.webp)

In multi-company databases, switch or combine companies from the top-right company switcher: 1. Click the active company name in the top-right bar. 2. Click a company name directly to switch to that single company, or toggle checkboxes beside multiple companies to view records across subsidiaries simultaneously. 3. Click **Confirm** to reload the workspace with the chosen company scope. 4. **Unsaved-Edit Guard**: If you have unsaved edits on a form or settings page, switching companies prompts you to **Remain** (keep editing) or **Discard** (abandon edits and switch).

Every major business record (**Contacts**, Invoices, Purchase Orders, Sales Orders, Transfers, Employees) includes a **Chatter** timeline alongside or below the form: * **Log note**: Record internal team notes visible only to internal users (for example, explaining a credit hold or warehouse delay). * **Send message**: Post a message to record followers and attach supporting files. * **Activity**: Schedule follow-up tasks (calls, emails, meetings, to-dos, with or without a deadline) directly on any record—including Contacts—and monitor upcoming or overdue items from the top-bar clock (**Activities**) menu. * **Audit & Tracking Trail**: Status transitions and tracked field changes (such as confirmation, posting, or manager reassignment) are logged chronologically in the chatter feed so you can audit who changed what and when. ![Record chatter preserves internal log notes, attachments, scheduled activities, and chronological field-change history directly on each document.](/en/next/assets/docs/assets/user-manual/getting-started/chatter-log-note.webp)

Click **Discuss** in the top navigation bar (or open **Discuss** from the App Switcher) for internal messaging synchronized with the quick-chat popover for your current session and company: * **Direct Messages & Group Channels**: Click **New message** and pick one colleague for a direct conversation, or select multiple colleagues and enter a group name. * **Saved & Notifications**: Bookmark important messages under **Saved**, and open **Notifications** to jump straight to the conversation or linked business record under your current access rights. ![The Discuss workspace organizes direct conversations, group channels, unread messages, saved bookmarks, and record notifications in one view.](/en/next/assets/docs/assets/user-manual/getting-started/discuss-workspace.webp)

* **External Email from Chatter**: Users with write access to a record can click **Email…** in Chatter, pick recipient contacts or type email addresses, attach files from that record, and click **Queue email**. * **Send Quotations & Invoices by Email**: Confirmed or draft **Quotations** and posted **Customer Invoices** offer **Send by Email**, attaching the document's formatted PDF automatically. Use **Preview PDF** to inspect the exact PDF bytes that will be queued (if you edit the document after previewing, discard and reopen the composer to regenerate the PDF). * **Email Templates, SMTP Relays & Queue Health**: Administrators configure company SMTP relays, edit **Document Email Templates** (supporting {document} and {total} placeholders translated per recipient language), and monitor delivery attempts or retry queued messages under **Settings → Technical → Mail → Outgoing Email / Outgoing Mail Queue**.

When an administrator configures an AI provider under **Settings → Technical → AI**, authorized users can open the **AI Assistant** either from the header icon (floating dock) or as a full-page **Canvas** workspace from the app switcher: 1. Open **AI Assistant** from the app switcher (or click the AI icon in the top bar to open the side dock while staying on your current form). 2. Pick a quick analysis prompt or type your question in **Ask a question…** and press **Enter** (Shift+Enter for a newline). 3. Your conversation stays scoped to your current browser tab, signed-in user, and active company, surviving navigation across ERP views until you sign out or refresh the session. 4. **Safe Read & Draft Policy**: The AI Assistant respects your exact ERP access rights and never posts accounting entries or confirms orders on its own. Any proposed draft document opens in a standard ERP form for your explicit review and confirmation. ![The full-page AI Assistant workspace provides quick operational prompts alongside your active company context.](/en/next/assets/docs/assets/user-manual/getting-started/ai-assistant-canvas.webp)

* **Required Field Highlights**: Clicking **Save** with missing required fields highlights the fields and moves focus to the first error (switching tabs automatically if needed). Complete the highlighted fields and click **Save** again. * **Uncertain Network Writes**: If a connection drops during a save, reload the record view first to check whether the server committed the change before retrying, avoiding duplicate submissions. * **Access Refusal**: If an action or menu reports insufficient permissions, check both your active company in the top-right switcher and your assigned role under **Settings → Users & Companies → Users**.

sections.text: Welcome to the ERPForAll User Manual. Every chapter in this manual reflects live end-to-end workflows verified across Accounting, Purchasing, Inventory, Sales, Human Resources, and Workspace administration. Before creating or posting transactions, always verify the active company in the top-right company switcher. ![The ERPForAll App Switcher gives one-click access to every installed business application.](/en/next/assets/docs/assets/user-manual/getting-started/app-switcher.webp)

ERPForAll links operational documents directly to inventory movements and statutory accounting entries so every department sees the same truth: 1. **Procure-to-Pay (Purchase → Inventory → Accounting)**: - A buyer creates a Request for Quotation (or calls off from a Purchase Agreement), optionally compares an Alternative RFQ, and confirms the Purchase Order. - The warehouse receives the shipment (creating a backorder if the delivery is short, or running a Quality Check if configured) and optionally applies Landed Costs for freight or customs. - Once received quantities update on the Purchase Order, Accounting creates the draft Vendor Bill (verified by 3-Way Match), posts it, and settles it via payment and bank reconciliation. 2. **Order-to-Cash (Sales → Inventory → Accounting)**: - A salesperson builds a Quotation using a Pricelist or Quotation Template and confirms it into a Sales Order. - The warehouse reserves available stock (respecting FIFO and lot/serial rules) and validates the Delivery Order. - Accounting creates a regular or down-payment Customer Invoice from the Sales Order, posts it, registers partial or full payment, and matches the bank receipt. 3. **Record-to-Report (Accounting → Controlling → Consolidation)**: - Every posted invoice, bill, payment, depreciation entry, and landed cost flows automatically into the General Ledger, Profit & Loss, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow Statement, and Analytic Cost Center reports. - Groups with multiple subsidiaries run Consolidation to produce group financial statements with intercompany eliminations and currency translation adjustments.

- **App Switcher**: Click the top-left grid icon to switch between Accounting, Purchase, Inventory, Sales, Employees, Contacts, Discuss, Approvals, AI Assistant, and Settings. - **Command Palette**: Press Cmd+K (macOS) or Ctrl+K (Windows/Linux)—or open **User Menu → Shortcuts**—to jump quickly to menus and commands. - **Interactive List Dashboard Strip**: Operational list views (Quotations, Sales Orders, RFQs, Purchase Orders, Invoices, Transfers, Quality Checks) feature a single-row KPI bar with color-coded icon cards and an inline period selector (Last 7 days, This month, etc.). Click any counter card to filter the table immediately, and click it again to clear. - **Top-Bar Discuss & Activities**: Click **Discuss** in the header to open your real-time team messaging workspace, or click the clock (**Activities**) icon to view pending and overdue tasks across all records. - **Company Context**: Check the active company name in the top-right header before creating documents. Multi-company users can select one or several companies at once. - **Smart Buttons & Breadcrumbs**: Use the stat buttons at the top of any form (such as **Delivery**, **Receipt**, **Invoices**, **Payments**, **Alternatives**, or **History**) to jump directly to linked records, then click the breadcrumb trail to return without losing filters.
